theme_and_archetype.archetype: 7 (Electric & Neon) combined with 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for trust
theme_and_archetype.mood: High-tech, premium privacy, cryptographic trust, vibrant but grounded.
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Balances the electric neon gradients of Solana (Purple/Green) with deep void blacks and glassmorphism to look trustworthy and not like a sketchy casino.

headings.rationale: Wide, tech-forward, crypto-native aesthetic. Strict banning of Inter/Roboto for headings.

monospace.usage: Used for all wallet addresses, transaction hashes, ZK proof commitments, and numeric data to convey technical precision.

surfaces.tracing_beam: Use mask-image and moving gradient for high-conversion areas (e.g., Deposit CTA).

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-none hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors
buttons.solana_glow: bg-transparent border border-[#14F195]/50 text-[#14F195] hover:bg-[#14F195]/10 hover:border-[#14F195] transition-all drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(20,241,149,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#121212] border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] transition-colors

navigation.items: Logo left, Links center, Connect Wallet button right. Mobile uses hamburger menu.

forms_and_inputs.style: bg-[#050505] border border-white/10 focus:border-[#9945FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#9945FF] text-white rounded-none transition-all placeholder:text-zinc-600

animations.micro_interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text and bg colors. Buttons should have slight scale effect (scale-95 on active).
animations.page_transitions: Fade in and slight upward translation (translate-y-4) on mount.
animations.complex_visuals: For Architecture visualization, use React Force Graph 3D or D3.js (simulated via CSS animations if libraries are not available) with pulsing glowing nodes representing ZK proofs and Relayers.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on dark gray/black backgrounds meets APCA standards.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#14F195] focus:outline-none).
accessibility.test_ids: Every button, input, tab, and major widget MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="connect-wallet-btn"`).

hero_background.description: Abstract ZK proofs and cryptography Merkle tree nodes with Solana purple/green glow. Self-host the asset and fill in the URL.

architecture_nodes.description: 3D geometric shapes for privacy nodes and layers. Self-host the asset and fill in the URL.

dashboard_texture.description: Subtle glowing data lines texture for dashboard backgrounds. Self-host the asset and fill in the URL.

solana_abstract.description: Abstract visual for Solana asset representation if needed. Self-host the asset and fill in the URL.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a React + Tailwind application. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing/landing pages, and Shadcn for complex inputs, dialogs, and tables. Use standard .js/.jsx extensions. Must install lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Implement client-side routing (react-router-dom) for Landing, Deposit, Withdraw, Relayer Status, Compliance, and Architecture.

pages.landing: Hero section with `hero_background` overlayed. Emphasize privacy for Bags.fm creators. Features bento grid.
pages.deposit_withdraw: Core dApp interface. Use `dashboard_texture` as subtle background. Implement forms for depositing SOL/SPL tokens, generating a 'secret note' (mocked), and a separate form for pasting the note to withdraw via relayers. Visualize the 'Range Risk API' compliance check before deposit.
pages.relayer_status: Data-heavy dashboard. Use 'Control Room' grid. List mocked relayers, uptime, fee percentages, and anonymity set sizes.
pages.compliance_check: Dashboard showing wallet risk scoring using progress bars or circular charts.
pages.architecture: An interactive or heavily animated page explaining the 4 pillars (Smart Contract, Bags API, Privacy Backend, Relayer). Use `architecture_nodes` image or CSS/SVG animations to show the deposit -> mixer -> withdraw flow.

instructions_to_main_agent.technical: All state is mocked (no real Web3 provider needed, just UI simulation). Show toast notifications (using sonner) for 'Generating ZK Proof...', 'Transaction Confirmed', etc.
